blocks.prompt: 7. Use Trapezoidal Rule to approximate the value of the definite integral \(\int_{-1}^{1} (x^{4} - x + 1)\,dx\) taking \(h = 0.2\).
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke yeh kis qisam ka sawal hai: definite integral ki value Trapezium Rule se approximately nikalni hai, seedha integration nahi karna.
Diya kya hai? Function \(f(x) = x^{4} - x + 1\), interval \([-1, 1]\), aur \(h = 0.2\) diya hai, to pehle \(n = \frac{b-a}{h}\) nikalna hoga.
Find kya karna hai? Integral ki approximate value, chaar decimal places tak.
Rule kaunsa aur kyun? Trapezium Rule, kyunke sawal yahi maangta hai: area ko barabar chaurai ki pattiyon (trapeziums) mein baant kar jama karna.
Plan: h ya n, phir points ki list, phir har point par function ki value, phir beech wali values ka jama, aur aakhir mein formula aur tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = x^{4} - x + 1\), \(a = -1\), \(b = 1\), \(h = 0.2\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{-1}^{1} (x^{4} - x + 1)\,dx\) ki approximate value.
Tareeqa: sawal khud Trapezium Rule maang raha hai, is liye wohi lagayenge. Yahan \(n\) nahi balke \(h\) diya hai, is liye pehle \(n = \frac{b-a}{h}\) nikalenge. Phir points aur un par function ki values (chaar decimal tak) nikal kar formula \(\frac{h}{2}[\text{pehli} + 2(\text{beech wali}) + \text{aakhri}]\) mein rakhenge.

Continuity
\(x^{4} - x + 1\) polynomial hai, aur polynomial har jagah continuous hota hai, is liye \([-1, 1]\) par bhi.
Kyun: Trapezium Rule continuous function ke liye bana hai; agar graph beech mein toot jaye to trapeziums us hisse ko sahi nahi dhaanp sakte.

Subintervals ki tadaad aur points
\[n = \dfrac{b-a}{h} = \dfrac{1-(-1)}{0.2} = \dfrac{2}{0.2} = 10\]
Points \(x_{i} = a + ih\): \(-1, -0.8, -0.6, -0.4, -0.2, 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1\)
Kyun: \(h = \frac{b-a}{n}\) ko ulat kar \(n = \frac{b-a}{h}\) milta hai, yani poori lambai mein \(h\) kitni dafa aata hai. 10 subintervals ke 11 points hain; har agla point pichle se \(h\) aage hai.

Function values (4 decimal places)
\[f(-1) = 3.0000\]
\[f(-0.8) = 2.2096\]
\[f(-0.6) = 1.7296\]
\[f(-0.4) = 1.4256\]
\[f(-0.2) = 1.2016\]
\[f(0) = 1.0000\]
\[f(0.2) = 0.8016\]
\[f(0.4) = 0.6256\]
\[f(0.6) = 0.5296\]
\[f(0.8) = 0.6096\]
\[f(1) = 1.0000\]
Kyun: har point ko function mein rakha. Negative \(x\) par dhyan: \(x^{4}\) positive rehta hai (even power), aur \(-x\) bhi positive ho jata hai. Misaal: \(f(-0.8) = 0.4096 + 0.8 + 1 = 2.2096\).
Dhyan dein: \(-(-0.8) = +0.8\); yahan sign ki ghalti sab se aam hai.
Neeche jawab ke saath di gayi table mein yahi values un ke weights (1 ya 2) ke saath hain.

Beech wali values jama karein
\[S = f(x_{1}) + \dots + f(x_{9})\]
\[= 2.2096 + 1.7296 + 1.4256\]
\[+ 1.2016 + 1.0000 + 0.8016\]
\[+ 0.6256 + 0.5296 + 0.6096\]
\[= 10.1328\]
Kyun: yeh 9 beech wali values har ek do saath wale trapeziums ki saanjhi deewar hain, is liye formula mein in ka jama do dafa (double) aayega. Pehle in ka jama alag nikal lena hisaab ko saaf aur check karne ke qabil banata hai.

Trapezium Rule apply karein
\[\int_{-1}^{1} (x^{4} - x + 1)\,dx\]
\[\approx \dfrac{h}{2}\big[f(x_{0}) + 2S + f(x_{10})\big]\]
\[= 0.1\big[3.0000 + 2(10.1328)\]
\[+ 1.0000\big]\]
\[= 0.1(24.2656)\]
\[= 2.42656 \approx 2.4266\]
Kyun: \(\frac{h}{2} = 0.1\). Kinaron wali do values ek ek dafa aayin aur beech wali values ka jama do dafa; phir poore bracket ko \(\frac{h}{2}\) se zarb diya. Round sirf aakhri jawab ko kiya, beech mein nahi, taake ghalti jama na ho.

Tasdeeq:
\[\int_{-1}^{1} (x^{4} - x + 1)\,dx = \Big[\dfrac{x^{5}}{5} - \dfrac{x^{2}}{2} + x\Big]_{-1}^{1}\]
\[= \dfrac{7}{10} + \dfrac{17}{10} = \dfrac{12}{5} = 2.4\]
Kyun: polynomial ka integral power rule se seedha nikalta hai: upper limit par \(\frac{1}{5} - \frac{1}{2} + 1 = \frac{7}{10}\) aur lower limit par \(-\frac{1}{5} - \frac{1}{2} - 1 = -\frac{17}{10}\); minus karne se \(\frac{24}{10} = 2.4\). Hamara jawab 2.4266 bohat qareeb hai (farq 0.0266), aur thora zyada hai kyunke \(x^{4}\) wala hissa upar ki taraf mudta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key 2.9411 likhti hai. Yeh sahi nahi ho sakta: exact value \(\frac{12}{5} = 2.4\) hai, aur \(h = 0.2\) ke saath rule \(0.1(24.2656) = 2.4266\) deta hai. Sahi jawab 2.4266 hai.
